services.name: Guided Tour / Field Trips
services.desc: Take a field trip to the Foxfire Museum! Go beyond the glass case and hike through Appalachian history during a tour of our outdoor museum. Our goal is for your students to leave with a sense of wonder and appreciation for tradition. Interested in learning more or ready to schedule your tour? Submit a field trip request or email walker.boswell@foxfire.org

services.name: Face Jug Pottery
services.desc: This fun class is all about the history and creation of a small traditional style face jug. Face Jugs have a rich history in Appalachia that reaches far beyond our region. These unique creations had both practical and legendary uses in day-to-day life. You will learn about the history of Face Jugs as you create your own jug using hand-building methods. Basic techniques of decoration with examples will be available as we turn your work into a one-of-a-kind creation. Please note that this is a two day experience!
